**Observations on test image:**
- Circular to round spots on soybean leaf
- Dark brown/black centers
- Distinct reddish-purple/brown borders around lesions
- Yellow-green halos surrounding the spots
- Multiple lesions scattered across upper leaf surface

**Key matching features:**
- The circular spots with **reddish-brown borders** and **yellow halos** are hallmark Frogeye leaf spot features
- Lesion shape is circular/round (not angular like bacterial blight or brown spot)
- Dark centers with defined reddish-purple rings match the description: "brown to grayish spots with brown-reddish borders"
- Reference image confirms the small, dark, circular lesion pattern

This clearly matches **Frogeye_leaf_spot** — the reference image also shows the same characteristic small, dark, circular lesions.
